get_config_ucf101: get the dataset config with num_classes for the UCF101 action recognition dataset
get_config_hmdb51: get the dataset config with num_classes for the HMDB51 action recognition dataset
get_config_kinetics: get the dataset config with num_classes for the Kinetics action recognition dataset
test_get_config: test the get_config function by calling it with UCF101, HMDB51, and Kinetics dataset names
review_get_config: review the get_config function to understand supported datasets and their class counts
